blurb: Guests ride a Hydra-Terra amphibious vehicle for a 100-minute tour, including 40 minutes on land and 60 minutes on water. The tour departs from Seaport Village or the Embarcadero and features narrated views of historic ships, military landmarks, and local wildlife such as sea lions. The vehicle is open-air and designed to keep passengers dry during the splashdown into the bay.

quotes.text: Very fun and educational tour. The whole thing from start to finish was great. I learned a lot about San Diego, and the difference between a seal and a sea lion. 53 years old here and I didn’t know! The drive was fun and the water was fun. Very comfortable. Before we knew it, it was over. We will definitely do it again next time we are in San Diego.

We live here in San Diego, but always wanted to take the kids on this tour, and I’m glad we did. It was a fun experience for all and worth doing at least once, even as a resident. We had Captain Reef and JJ working the tour, and they were great! Check it out if you have the time! Nothing nicer than being on the water in San Diego!

Such a great tour! I knew we’d see some seals but didn’t realize we had a chance to see dolphins too. Lots of great information was shared about San Diego and the nearby areas. Lots of information about the various Navy ships and the San Diego Naval history too. Not just facts, but Lt. Dan made it fun, too.

My granddaughter and I were treated like royalty and enjoyed our tour with Gordon and JJ! They were so helpful and kind getting my wheelchair on and off the “bus/amphibian”. It was amazing to see the sea lions, all the birds and the navy training a dolphin! Thank you for a great experience!

Totally recommend doing this tour ride! It was very calming after a really long day of walking! We took our tour with Cameron and Jewels, and both were amazing! Jewels really knows her stuff and is very knowledgeable. She was very entertaining and kept everyone engaged.
Best experience I had whilst visiting San Diego. Knowledgeable guides and amazing views. Great tour and great value for money.
